response.summary: The frontier looks like a one-hot perturbation sweep around a single winning hypothesis rather than a genuinely competitive population. Only the anchor hypothesis (alpha-team/sighted/comet-q/alpha-observatory/transit-timing-method, interval narrowed to [1950,1950]) carries real opinion mass (b=0.574, u=0.426). All 7 other hypotheses are pinned at the maximal-uncertainty vacuous state (b=0, d=0, u=1.0), each differing from the anchor by exactly one swapped categorical slot *plus* a simultaneous reversion of the interval back to the full [1900,1999] range. This dual change confounds any ablation: it's impossible to tell from the population whether belief is tracking actor/action/object/place identity or is simply an artifact of narrowing the interval to a single year. Additionally, the mechanism slot ('transit-timing-method') never varies across any of the 8 hypotheses — no alternative method or negative-control mechanism was ever generated, unlike every other slot. No hypothesis in the set has any disbelief mass (d=0 everywhere), and the uniform, exact u=1.0 on all seven non-anchor hypotheses is suspicious enough to also raise a pipeline-health question about whether those variants were ever actually passed through evidence fusion versus being freshly spawned and left unscored. Atomicity values track a fixed per-actor prior (alpha-team constant at 0.8808 regardless of what claim is attached to that actor) rather than varying with the specific claim, and the "other-object"/"other-actor"/"other-action" values look like generic negative-control placeholders rather than concrete named rival candidates, suggesting shallow enumeration of real dissenting readings. Overall the population shows no dissenting cluster with any evidentiary traction and no evidence of a second, independently-narrowed rival hypothesis — classic signs of premature convergence around one candidate. (This assessment is based purely on the structural pattern of the given opinion data; any inference about how the underlying subjective-logic fusion pipeline is supposed to behave is model-prior/unverified, not confirmed pipeline documentation.)
flags: Premature single-anchor convergence: only 1/8 hypotheses has non-trivial belief; all 7 others sit at exact maximal vacuous uncertainty (b=0,d=0,u=1.0) with no partial dissent or partial support anywhere in the frontier.

Confounded ablation design: every non-anchor hypothesis simultaneously swaps one categorical slot AND reverts the interval to the full [1900,1999] range; there is no control hypothesis holding the anchor's exact actor/action/object/place/mechanism while only widening the interval, so the narrow-interval effect can't be separated from the actor/action/object/place effect.

Frozen slot: mechanism='transit-timing-method' is invariant across all 8 hypotheses; unlike actor, action, object, and place, mechanism has never received even a generic 'other-mechanism' negative-control probe.

Zero disbelief across the entire population (d=0 for all 8) combined with exact-uniform u=1.0 on all non-anchor hypotheses, raising a pipeline-health concern that these variants may be unprocessed/stale spawns rather than genuinely evidence-rejected readings.

Atomicity (base rate) appears to be a fixed per-actor lookup (alpha-team always 0.8808, beta-team 0.8176, unverified-observer 0.1824, other-actor 0.6225) that does not vary with the specific action/object/place/interval attached to that actor, i.e., trust priors aren't claim-sensitive, only actor-sensitive.

No competing/rival cluster exists: no second candidate (e.g., beta-team or other-actor combined with a narrowed 1950-adjacent interval) has been spawned to hedge against the anchor's narrow-interval reading being overfit.

'Other-object'/'other-action'/'other-actor' values look like generic negative-control placeholders rather than concrete, named alternative candidates, suggesting shallow exploration of real dissenting readings for those slots.
recommended_actions: Recombine: spawn a control hypothesis with the anchor's exact actor/action/object/place/mechanism but the wide [1900,1999] interval, to isolate whether narrowing-to-1950 alone (versus actor identity) is driving the belief mass.

Widen: generate at least one alternative-mechanism hypothesis (e.g., a distinct observation method) to break the invariant mechanism slot and test whether transit-timing-method itself is load-bearing for the belief.

Split: create a rival cluster around the second-most-plausible actor (beta-team or other-actor) with an interval independently narrowed near 1950, to see if narrowing transfers belief to competitors too or is uniquely diagnostic of alpha-team.
Verify pipeline health: re-run/confirm evidence fusion on the 7 flat (u=1.0) hypotheses to rule out that they are simply unscored/stale spawns rather than genuinely evidence-neutral readings.

Generalize: replace generic 'other-object'/'other-actor'/'other-action' placeholders with concrete, named rival candidates (a second real comet, observer, or observatory) to obtain genuine dissenting hypotheses instead of undifferentiated negative controls.

Introduce hypotheses/evidence checks capable of producing explicit disbelief (d>0) so the frontier isn't limited to a belief-vs-total-uncertainty binary; test whether any evidence actively contradicts the alternates.
